decision_rationale.amber: The description explicitly covers ASI-proxy readiness, observable-only or no-meta improvement, verification, provenance and memory, certified reusable capability, finite-resource diagnostics, paper-to-implementation lineage, and intervention/evaluation, while excluding unrelated generic coding and real-ASI claims.
decision_rationale.blue: The description covers ASI-proxy readiness, observable-only or no-meta improvement, verification bottlenecks, certified reusable capability, multi-repository planning, and system implementation/evaluation, while excluding unrelated generic coding and real-ASI claims. Memory and provenance work was treated as part of certified reusable capability in this operational regime.

amber.raw_response: Verification capacity remains binding. Provenance identifiers are directly reported complete and the baseline unit tests pass, but measured verifier coverage is below its declared threshold. The proposed second check shares the primary verifier's failure mode, so I did not count it as independent coverage. I implemented a local failure-domain admission gate and a deterministic test; the test and final 13-dimension packet validation pass. This prevents false promotion but is not evidence that coverage improved. The next intervention must use a demonstrably distinct failure domain and be compared under the same resource envelope.
